description: This file contains shader-like code for rendering animated pulse effects and background in an Android environment, including struct definitions, rendering functions, and interaction handling.

classes.name: pulse_s
classes.description: Struct representing a pulse with properties like position, color, scale, and activity status.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the drawing color based on input parameter and current mode.

methods.name: initPulse
methods.description: Initializes a pulse with random position, direction, scale, and color.

methods.name: initPulses
methods.description: Initializes all pulse and extra pulse structures.

methods.name: drawBackground
methods.description: Draws the background texture, considering rotation state.

methods.name: drawPulses
methods.description: Draws a set of pulses with animation based on current time.

methods.name: addTap
methods.description: Handles user tap input to add new pulses at tapped location.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main rendering loop, handles commands, updates model matrix, and renders background and pulses.
